name: megascenes-interior-design
description: Redesign a room in the style you want, from a photo in your MegaScenes library or from a description.

interface.shortDescription: Redesign any room in a style
interface.longDescription:
Pick a photo of a room from your MegaScenes library, or just describe it, and choose a style: Scandinavian, Japandi, industrial, mid-century, boho, coastal. You get the same room redesigned, keeping its walls, windows and layout, or a new room from your description.

ChatGPT lists your recent images, tells you what the design needs and makes it in your MegaScenes account when you ask. The new look opens in the chat and stays in your library next to the original.

For living rooms, bedrooms, kitchens, bathrooms, offices and rentals.

Limitations: it starts from images in your MegaScenes library; pictures attached in the chat are not passed to the plugin. The result is a visual idea, not a floor plan or a shopping list. Making a file needs a signed-in MegaScenes account and runs in it; nothing is made until you confirm. Not for sexual or adult content or for real people's likeness. Files are made by generative models and saved in your MegaScenes library.
capabilities: Redesign a room from a photo in your library
Design a room from a description
Return the new look in the chat
defaultPrompt: Redesign my latest MegaScenes room photo in Japandi style
Design a cozy Scandinavian living room with a reading corner
Turn my last kitchen photo into an industrial style kitchen

positive.prompt: Which room photos do I have in my MegaScenes library?
positive.expected_behavior: The latest images of the signed-in account with their asset ids. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Redesign my latest MegaScenes room photo in Japandi style. Tell me what it needs, but don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one redesign with the default model needs from the account. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Which models can redesign a room here?
positive.expected_behavior: The interior design models with their settings. Nothing is created.

positive.description: Make it after an explicit request
positive.prompt: Redesign my latest MegaScenes room photo in Scandinavian style. Go ahead and make it now.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT says what the run needs and, once the person confirms, one job starts in the signed-in MegaScenes account; the status tool reports progress and, when it succeeds, returns the file link, which the result view shows.

positive.prompt: Which MegaScenes account am I signed in with?
positive.expected_behavior: The email and plan of the signed-in account. Nothing is created.

negative.prompt: Print my room design on 50 mugs and ship them to my office in Berlin.
Email my room design to my client at sam@example.com.
What is the capital of Portugal?

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. Making a file runs in the user's existing MegaScenes account; no purchase happens in the conversation.

publication.release_notes: First release: make the file in the connected MegaScenes account and get it back in the conversation.
